title.narrative: Living lab: Enabling local economic development and climate resilience through green businesses

description.narrative: Under the fast pace of urbanization, cities and metropolitan regions around the world are confronted with complex (societal) challenges, amongst which climate change. The dynamics of urban growth in Pereira city and Metropolitan area are characterized by changes in land use that result in an increase of the population's vulnerability and exposure to natural disasters. This situation creates environmental degradation, problems with connectivity and accessibility, and reduces quality of life of the inhabitants due to lack of integration of urban, peri-urban, and rural areas.This project aims to study the possibilities to create a green corridor as a living lab in Pereira city and scale it up to the Central West Metropolitan Area. Through this pioneering project, other Colombian and Latin American cities can benefit as well, since other intermediate cities are currently confronted with similar issues. The innovative solutions that will be proposed in this project to develop a green corridor in Pereira and metropolitan area, can open the opportunities to the private sector through international collaboration and through a Business2City approach.After a preliminary research and needs assessment, workshops will be organized to explore options and build a shared vision and agenda setting of green innovations, and to identify priority themes and a portfolio of projects. This will result in design of two project proposals to give shape to the Sustainable Cities sector strategy.
